content:
Asha CSM: Quick heads-up: a subset of onboarding flows failed at the final verification step for tenants using private key rotation. Reports started at 11:02 UTC. :frowning:
Dev Ops: Investigating. I see elevated 502 responses from verification-service between 11:02-11:10. Tracing to the rotation worker.
Marta Eng: Root cause appears to be a regression in the rotation worker where expired cache entries were not refreshed, causing verification calls to stall. We rolled back the rotation-worker image at 11:12 and restarted the job.
Lee Support: Can we get an affected-account list? I have customers already messaging CSMs.
Ken AM: Pulling accounts with onboarding started past 21 days and renewals <90 days; will DM P1 list now.
Asha CSM: Need two messages: 1) short broad notice to affected tenants, 2) personalized outreach for top 8 at renewal risk. Keep tone apologetic and actionable.
Ravi (CS Director): Offer a hands-on recovery session and consider goodwill credits for any launch delays. Keep finance in the loop.
NotifyBot: rollback completed: rotation-worker image rolled back on cluster prod-b at 11:12 (deploy id: dpl-79901).
Dev Ops: Post-rollback metrics: verification 5xxs dropped to baseline within 4m; backlog of verification jobs is processing at ~85% throughput.
Asha CSM: Draft - general notice:

Asha CSM: ```
Hi <CustomerName>,
We wanted to let you know some customers experienced an intermittent failure during the final verification step of onboarding earlier today. We've reverted the update causing the issue and most onboarding processes have resumed. If you experienced a failure, reply here and we'll open a priority ticket and help finish setup. We apologize for the disruption.
```

Lee Support: Adding ticket template fields: "verification step", "last seen error", "needs live assist".
Marta Eng: Engineering follow-up items: add cache-refresh test in CI, add alert when verification job latency spikes >300ms, and schedule a postmortem with timeline and action items.
Ken AM: I'll call the top 8 and offer a free 30-minute onboarding assist. Logging outcomes in tracker: https://docs.redwood.ai/tracker/onboard-4160001111
Ravi (CS Director): If any customer expresses renewal concern escalate to me. We'll standardize any credit offers.
Asha CSM: Communications cadence: initial outbound now, 1hr update if backlog >10%, RCA + credit decision within 48h. Please include a quick survey question in the follow-up: "Did you need hands-on help to complete onboarding? (Yes/No)"
Lee Support: Survey added to ticket and outbound template.
Asha CSM: Thanks team 44d I'll send the messages and lock thread after initial send.
